detail.longDescription: 🚨 Dockhand CVE-2026-53988 — CVSS 10.0 Unsigned webhook request → arbitrary stack redeployment. Default config (null webhook secret) is fully exposed. Worst case: attacker-controlled docker-compose.yml → container escape → host compromise. Fix: upgrade to 1.0.40, set a webhook secret. 🔗 https:// threataft.com/articles/dockhan d-cve-2026-53988-unauthenticated-webhook-authentication-bypass # CVE # Dockhand # Docker # InfoSec # Vulnerability # threatintel # cybersecurity
